description: Step 4 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: a branch published as a checkpoint. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo, the branch, the title and the three sections of the text (problem, behaviour, verification), with base and forge_repo optional. The branch head is recorded first and every later step refuses if it moved. The text is written to a file in the first person under the headings Problem, Behaviour and Verification, and refused if it names a model, a session or a tool signature, or quotes anyone. The delivery policy is read from the trusted trunk; `ask` hands the push to a person. The publication gate runs on the commits before the push and on the text before the pull request. Every forge call runs as the account the tree declares in sailor.forgeAs, and the step refuses when none is declared. The run is complete only when the remote branch carries the recorded commit and an open draft pull request reads that same head.

env.REQUIRED: repo branch title problem behaviour verification

with.command:
set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/pull-request-$(printf '%s' "$BRANCH" | tr '/' '-').md"
FILE="$file" python3 -c '
import json, os, re, sys
sections = [("Problem", os.environ["PROBLEM"]), ("Behaviour", os.environ["BEHAVIOUR"]), ("Verification", os.environ["VERIFICATION"])]
for heading, text in sections:
    if not text.strip():
        sys.exit("the %s section is empty" % heading)
body = "\n\n".join("## %s\n\n%s" % (heading, text.strip()) for heading, text in sections) + "\n"
whole = os.environ["TITLE"] + "\n" + body
if not re.search(r"\b(I|I am|I have|my|me)\b", body):
    sys.exit("the pull request text is not written in the first person")
named = re.search(r"(?i)\b(claude|codex|gemini|gpt-?[0-9]|opus|sonnet|haiku|anthropic|openai|llm|language model|co-authored-by|generated with|session id|session_id|claude-session)\b", whole)
if named:
    sys.exit("the pull request text names a model, a session or a tool signature: " + named.group(0))
if re.search(r"(?m)^\s*>", body):
    sys.exit("the pull request text quotes someone: a blockquote is not how this text speaks")
with open(os.environ["FILE"], "w") as out:
    out.write(body)
print(json.dumps({"body_file": os.environ["FILE"]}))
'

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
said=$(sailor policy) || { echo "the delivery policy could not be resolved from the trusted trunk" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$said" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
fields = dict(line.split(": ", 1) for line in lines[:-1])
for key in ("merge", "push", "release"):
    if fields.get(key) not in ("auto", "ask"):
        sys.exit("the policy does not say auto or ask for " + key)
print(json.dumps({
    "merge": fields["merge"], "push": fields["push"], "release": fields["release"],
    "read_from": lines[-1],
    "asks_publication": "ask" if fields["push"] == "ask" else "auto",
    "asks_integration": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["merge"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
    "asks_release": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["release"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
}))
'

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit
) asks a person before this flow may push the branch and open or update its draft pull request. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

with.command:
set -eu
cd "$REPO"
now=$(git rev-parse --verify "refs/heads/$BRANCH^{commit}")
[ "$now" = "$REF" ] || { echo "$BRANCH moved from $REF to $now since the checkpoint was recorded; run the flow again" >&2; exit 1; }
set +e
if [ -n "$BASE" ]; then "$REPO/scripts/privacy-scan.sh" "$REF" "$BASE" >&2; else "$REPO/scripts/privacy-scan.sh" "$REF" >&2; fi
code=$?
set -e
[ "$code" -eq 0 ] || { echo "publication gate: privacy-scan exited $code on $REF; nothing leaves" >&2; exit "$code"; }
printf '{"ref":"%s","privacy_exit":0}' "$REF"

set -eu
url=$(git -C "$REPO" remote get-url origin) || { echo "the tree has no origin remote" >&2; exit 1; }
set -- -C "$REPO"
case "$url" in
    http://*|https://*)
        push_as=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.pushAs) || { echo "sailor.pushAs is not declared on this tree: refusing to push with the machine's own credentials" >&2; exit 1; }
        helper='!f() { printf "%s\\n" username=x-access-token; printf "password=%s\\n" "$(gh auth token --user "'"$push_as"'")"; }; f'
        set -- -C "$REPO" -c credential.helper= -c "credential.helper=$helper" ;;
esac
remote=$(git -C "$REPO" ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" | awk '{ print $1 }')
if [ "$remote" != "$HEAD_COMMIT" ]; then
    git "$@" push origin "$HEAD_COMMIT:refs/heads/$BRANCH" >&2
fi
printf '{"pushed":"%s"}' "$HEAD_COMMIT"

set -eu
remote=$(git -C "$REPO" ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" | awk '{ print $1 }')
[ "$remote" = "$HEAD_COMMIT" ] || { echo "the remote branch $BRANCH reads ${remote:-nothing}, not $HEAD_COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"remote_head":"%s"}' "$remote"

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
set +e
"$REPO/scripts/privacy-scan.sh" --text "$TEXT_FILE" >&2
code=$?
set -e
[ "$code" -eq 0 ] || { echo "publication gate: privacy-scan --text exited $code on $TEXT_FILE; the text does not leave" >&2; exit "$code"; }
printf '{"text_file":"%s","privacy_exit":0}' "$TEXT_FILE"

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
forge_as=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs) || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is not declared on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "$forge_as" ] || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is empty on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
gh auth token --user "$forge_as" >/dev/null || { echo "no forge token for the declared account $forge_as" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -z "$FORGE_REPO" ] || export GH_REPO="$FORGE_REPO"
number=$(GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user "$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs)") gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
if [ -z "$number" ]; then
    GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user "$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs)") gh pr create --draft --base "$BASE" --head "$BRANCH" --title "$TITLE" --body-file "$BODY_FILE" >&2
else
    GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user "$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs)") gh pr edit "$number" --title "$TITLE" --body-file "$BODY_FILE" >&2
fi
tries=0
while :; do
    seen=$(GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user "$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs)") gh pr view "$BRANCH" --json number,url,isDraft,headRefOid,state --jq '[.number, .url, .isDraft, .headRefOid, .state] | @tsv')
    number=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f1); url=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f2); draft=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f3)
    oid=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f4); state=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f5)
    [ "$oid" = "$HEAD_COMMIT" ] && break
    tries=$((tries + 1))
    [ "$tries" -lt 10 ] || { echo "the pull request for $BRANCH reads head $oid, not $HEAD_COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
    sleep 3
done
[ "$state" = OPEN ] || { echo "the pull request for $BRANCH is $state, not OPEN" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"number":%s,"url":"%s","draft":%s,"head":"%s"}' "$number" "$url" "$draft" "$oid"
